d:
Bihar ke gaya men dipavli ke tyohar ko lekar is bar diye aur mombattiyon ka ek behad ajab-gajab bajar saj gaya hai. paranprik rup se banne vale mitti ke diyon ke sath-sath is sal bajar men kaee tarah ke aadhunik aur kritrim diye bhi grahkon ko aakarshit kar rahe hain. vahin, gharon ko roshan karne ke lie mombattiyon ki bhi kaee naee aur anokhi kismen dukanon par uplabdh hain.
